description: At a starting price of Rs. 42,900 for the 41mm band, the Pixel Watch 5 is a solid contender for the best smartwatch of 2026. But it isn't perfect. It feels short on health features, as the most marketing-heavy ones, like blood pressure trends, insulin resistance tracking, and breathing emergency detection, are not available at launch, and depending on where you live, some may not arrive for months.
title: Google Pixel Watch 5 Review: Same Face, Smarter Brain

description: The hacker linked to the third wave of Coldcard wallet attacks has begun swapping stolen Bitcoin for Ether through THORChain. Galaxy Research’s Alex Thorn tracked the transactions to a new Ethereum address and shared it with organisations monitoring the funds. Some swaps reportedly failed, potentially because of technical issues or insufficient liquidity.
title: Coldcard Hacker Converts Stolen Bitcoin to ETH Through THORChain

description: Xiaomi has showcased the Xiaomi 18 Fold at IFA 2026 in Berlin. The foldable flagship is the first smartphone from Xiaomi to be powered by its next-generation XRING O3 chip. Further, Xiaomi's Human x Car x Home Product Portfolio brings together more than 380 products across cooking and food storage, home cleaning, air management, audiovisual entertainment, safety and security, personal devices and smart mobility.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold Showcased at IFA 2026, Previews More Than 380 Products

description: Airtel customers can now access Super Duolingo for a year without paying an additional subscription fee. The benefit is available to Airtel mobile, Wi-Fi and DTH users through the Airtel Thanks app. Super Duolingo removes ads and provides unlimited energy, personalised exercises, mistake reviews and AI-powered speaking practice. Duolingo offers language courses in more than 40 languages and has expanded its India-focused catalogue with English courses for speakers of several Indian languages, including Punjabi, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil and Urdu.
title: Airtel Offers 1-Year Free Super Duolingo Subscription to Customers

description: Grok Bot is now available on Android. The Grok Bot entered beta in August. It was initially available on Linux, macOS and iOS. Now, it is listed on the Google Play Store. Grok Bot is jointly developed by SpaceXAI and Cursor. It was introduced as an always-on agent with their own computer, working inside tools and apps like humans. Grok Bot is available for users with SuperGrok and Cursor subscription plans.
title: Grok Bot Now Available on Android After Debuting on Linux, macOS and iOS

description: Mivi will launch its first smartphone, the Mivi One 5G, in India on September 24. The handset will be manufactured in Hyderabad and sold through Flipkart. It will use a Qualcomm Snapdragon 5G platform, although the specific chipset remains unknown. Mivi has also identified Google as a strategic partner without detailing its role. A teaser points to a clean software experience, while the phone has appeared in green. Its price and full specifications remain undisclosed, with earlier leaks suggesting a sub-Rs. 15,000 positioning.
title: Mivi One 5G India Launch Date Announced, Camera Design Teased

description: Canva on Thursday announced multiple new features that will soon be rolled out across its Visual Suite, including Docs, Sheets, Whiteboards, Websites, and Presentations. The visual communication platform is adding new visual layouts and formatting controls to Canva Docs. Apart from this, Canva Sheets and Whiteboards are being upgraded with additional AI capabilities and the Follow Collaborators feature, respectively. The company has also announced that Canva Presentation now has over 100 million monthly users.
title: Canva Launches Multiple Visual Suite Features Across Docs, Sheets, Whiteboards, Websites and More

description: Australia’s financial regulator has warned crypto businesses relying on temporary enforcement relief to apply for the licences they need by September 30. ASIC said firms operating without the required authorisation from October 1 could face legal consequences, including penalties of up to 10 percent of annual turnover.
title: Australia Sets September 30 Deadline for Crypto Firm Licensing

description: Since 2020, Samsung’s Fan Edition (FE) models have served as the entry point into the company’s flagship Galaxy S lineup, without premium cost that is usually associated with them. The idea is fairly simple: take the flagship experience and trim a few corners, so that it becomes more accessible to the masses. The new Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, launched globally last month, continues that approach. This year’s model, however, feels more like an evolution of the formula than a major departure.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE First Impressions

description: WhatsApp launched its Bill Payments feature in India on Thursday. It allows users to find, manage and pay household and utility bills without leaving the messaging app. To facilitate transactions, the Meta-owned messaging platform leverages the Bharat Connect (BBPS) network. Users can access 22,722 billers across 30 categories, including electricity, gas, water, FASTag, insurance, credit card and loan repayments. The feature is being rolled out gradually and will be available to Android and iOS users across India over the coming weeks.
title: WhatsApp Bill Payments Feature Launches in India With Support for UPI, Card Payments Across 30 Categories

description: Huawei announced two new wearable devices at IFA 2026. The Watch 6 series follows the earlier Watch 5 series and continues to use its X-Tap sensor for continuous health-metric measurements. It also announced the previously unveiled Watch GT 7 and Watch GT 7 Pro globally.
title: Huawei Watch 6 and Watch 6 Pro Announced at IFA 2026; Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro Tag Along

description: Weibo tipster has shared leaked renders of the iQOO 16. The renders show the phone in black and white colourways with a redesigned rear camera module. It appears to have a large, square-shaped rear camera island with rounded corners. The three camera sensors are arranged in a connected layout inside the module.
title: iQOO 16 Renders Leaked Again; Could Feature New Rear Camera Design

description: Samsung’s Exynos 2700 has reportedly surfaced in a leaked die shot ahead of its expected 2027 debut. The upcoming processor could feature a 10-core CPU with two Arm C2 Ultra cores, alongside eight C2 Pro cores. It is also tipped to use an Xclipse 970 GPU with 16 compute units based on AMD’s RDNA 5 architecture. Other reported details include 40MB of cache, LPDDR6 support and Samsung’s second-generation 2nm SF2P manufacturing process.
title: Samsung Exynos 2700 Leak Reveals a Major CPU Redesign, Bigger GPU and LPDDR6 Support

description: An old Rain Card contract on Solana was exploited, affecting stablecoin-funded card programmes operated by services including Avici and Tria. Blockaid said the attacker targeted collateral contracts rather than customers’ self-custodial wallets or private keys. Rain identified the flaw in a small number of older contract deployments and upgraded those still running the vulnerable version.
title: Smart Contract Exploit Drains $1.1 Million From Rain Card Users

description: Homegrown brand AI+ announced the roll out the NxtQuantum OS v1.1 update for its smartphones on Thursday. As per the company, the update focuses on privacy, security and more transparency into how apps access device resources and user data. Among the new additions is NxtPrivacy Dashboard, which is claimed to unify app permissions into a single interface. The company says NxtQuantum OS v1.1’s security framework analyses source rules across more than 1,000 connections and 172 unique destination IPs.
title: AI+ NxtQuantum OS v1.1 Rolled Out With Privacy Dashboard, Background Activity Alerts and Network Diagnostics

description: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G is tipped to arrive with two storage configurations and three colour choices. A new leak suggests that the handset will offer 128GB and 256GB storage options in Black, Light Blue and Silver. Earlier Geekbench testing revealed a MediaTek Helio G99 chipset and 4GB RAM, while the phone is expected to run Android 17 with One UI 9. Other leaked details include a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display, 90Hz refresh rate and a 5,000mAh battery.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G Leak Reveals Storage Options and Colour Variants

description: Vivo V80 Lite 5G has been launched in select global markets. The pricing details and exact sale date of the phone remain under wraps. However, the smartphone will be available for purchase in 6GB + 128GB, 6GB + 256GB, and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations. The handset will go on sale via the Vivo Malaysia online store in Black, Green, and Pink colour options. It sports a 6.83-inch 1.5K (1,260 x 2,800 pixels) AMOLED display, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate and 449 pixel density. A 6nm octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset powers the Vivo V80 Lite 5G.
title: Vivo V80 Lite 5G Launched Globally With 10,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Availability, Features

description: Qualcomm is gearing up to introduce its next-generation flagship mobile processor at the Snapdragon Summit in Hawaii later this month. Ahead of the announcement, the US-based chipmaker has detailed the GPU upgrades that its chipset will have. The chip, widely referred to as the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6, is confirmed to feature a new Adreno GPU featuring Adreno Matrix Cores for AI workloads, alongside a new rendering technology called Adreno Neural Fusion.
title: Qualcomm’s Next-Gen Snapdragon Chip to Feature New Adreno GPU With Matrix Cores, Neural Fusion

description: Samsung Galaxy A 57 5G has started receiving the Android 17-based One UI 9 beta update in India, according to a tipster. Further, the tipster claims that the company has started rolling out the beta version to the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 6 and Galaxy Z Flip 6 in South Korea. The beta version upgrades the smartphone to Android 17, introducing new features and design. As per the screenshot, the size of the update is 2.3GB. It also brings the latest August 2026 security patch to the handset.
title: Samsung One UI 9 Beta Reportedly Rolls Out to Galaxy A57 5G in India, Galaxy Z Fold 6 and Flip 6 in South Korea

description: Bitcoin is holding around the Rs. 73.5 lakh level as investors await Friday’s US employment report for clues on the Federal Reserve’s September policy decision. Higher oil prices and geopolitical tensions are weighing on risk appetite, while inconsistent ETF demand has reduced institutional support. Analysts recommend cautious positioning ahead of the key data release.
title: Bitcoin Holds Around $77,700 as Investors Await US Jobs Report for Fed Rate Clues

description: Among the numerous features Apple demoed at WWDC 2026, ‘iPhone Handoff’ was briefly touched on stage. The feature basically lets a user use two iPhones with the same number. It works like a companion eSIM, an operator feature introduced earlier for wearables. With iOS 27 release on the horizon, a developer has now demonstrated how it works and explained its limitations.
title: iPhone Handoff Could Be Coming to iOS 27, Letting Users Share a Number Across Two iPhones

description: Vivo's Product Manager Han Boxiao confirmed that Vivo has brought the same main camera sensor used on last year's X300 Pro to the standard X500. The Vivo X500 will come with a Sony LYTIA-828 main camera sensor with a 1/1.28-inch size. It is teased to feature the Sony LYTIA-610 sensor as the Vivo X500 Pro's APO telephoto camera. The sensor will offer 64-megapixel resolution and CIPA 5.5-rated stabilisation.
title: Vivo X500 Camera Details Officially Revealed; Teased to Feature Sony LYTIA-828 Main Sensor

description: JioPC is now available as a standalone cloud computing service that works on existing computers, regardless of the user's telecom or broadband provider. The service offers up to 16GB RAM and 1TB storage through the cloud, targeting older PCs with performance, storage or software limitations. Jio says users can activate the service in under five minutes without installing hardware or migrating data. The updated service is available in two variants, with subscription plans starting at Rs. 1,000 for two months.
title: JioPC Expands Beyond JioHome, Lets Users Turn Existing Computers Into Cloud PCs

description: Acer Swift Blade 14, Swift Air 16 (2026), Aspire G 3D 16, Aspire S 27 AiO, and Aspire S 24 AiO were launched ahead of IFA 2026. The new Acer Swift Blade 14 and Swift Air 16 (2026) will be available for purchase in EMEA in December. Moreover, the Swift Air 16 (2026) will also be available in the North American region in the first quarter of 2027. On the other hand, the Acer Aspire S 27 AiO and Aspire S 24 AiO will be available for purchase in the EMEA region in the fourth quarter of 2026. Meanwhile, the tech giant will announce the availability details of the Acer Aspire G 3D 16 later.
title: IFA 2026: Acer Swift Blade 14, Swift Air 16 (2026) Launched With Up to Intel Core 7, Aspire G 3D 16 Tags Along

description: Vivo has teased the upcoming Vivo Buds true wireless stereo earbuds for the Indian market. While the company has yet to announce their price, launch date or availability, its global product page offers details about a Vivo Buds model that could be similar to the India-bound version. The listed features include 10mm drivers, AI call noise reduction, Bluetooth 5.4, multipoint connectivity, an IP54 rating and a claimed 50-hour battery life. The earbuds could also resemble the recently launched iQOO Buds.
title: Vivo Buds India Launch Teased: Expected Features and Details

description: Oukitel WP600, WP70 Ultra and WP63 smartphones unveiled ahead of IFA 2026. The Oukitel WP600 is a gaming-focused model and features an active cooling system. The Oukitel WP70 Ultra houses a 16,000mAh battery. The Oukitel WP63 features an electronic outdoor igniter and a 20,000mAh battery. Price and availability details of the new phones are yet to be confirmed.
title: Oukitel WP600, WP70 Ultra and WP63 Rugged Phones With Up 20,000mAh Battery Unveiled Ahead of IFA 2026

description: iPhone 18 Pro series will also be launched in a silver colour option, new leak suggests. Tipster Sonny Dickson (@SonnyDickson) has shared an image, which seemingly shows the SIM trays of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. In the image, the purported SIM tray of the iPhone 18 Pro series appears in burgundy, blue, and silver shades, hinting that the lineup could be available for purchase in the same silver colourway as its predecessor. Interestingly, the new leak contradicts a recent report, which also suggested that the iPhone 18 Pro series will be launched in three new colour options.
title: iPhone 18 Pro Series Could Bring Back Silver Colour, New Leak Suggests

description: Redmi 17 5G has been launched in India. The smartphone is scheduled to go on sale in the country soon via Amazon and will be available for purchase in Absolute Black, Endless Blue, and Eternal Orange colour options. The handset is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 chipset. It is also equipped with a 7,900mAh battery with support for 45W wired fast charging and 22.5W reverse wired charging. The Redmi 17 5G carries a dual rear camera setup, led by a 50-megapixel primary shooter. It also features an 8-megapixel selfie camera.
title: Redmi 17 5G Launched in India With 7,900mAh Battery, Snapdragon 4 Gen 5 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Acer has announced the Predator Atlas 7 as a new Windows gaming handheld for the global market. The device will arrive in North America in the fourth quarter of 2026 and in EMEA from November, with India availability yet to be confirmed. It features a 7-inch Full HD display with a 120Hz refresh rate, Intel Arc graphics, up to 24GB RAM and 1TB storage. Other specifications include Thunderbolt 4 ports, Wi-Fi 7, optional TMR joysticks and a battery of up to 80Wh.
title: IFA 2026: Acer Predator Atlas 7 Unveiled With Intel Arc Graphics, Up to 80Wh Battery

description: Anthropic announced the Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 models for coding and knowledge work and long-running problem-solving tasks. Claude Fable 5.1 is generally available, while Mythos 5.1 is available only through Anthropic's trusted access programmes and its safeguards are specifically designed to support work in cybersecurity and the life sciences.
title: Anthropic Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Mythos 5.1 Models Announced for Advanced Coding, Scientific Research

description: Netflix is introducing Southverse, a new collection page for members in India, the company told Gadgets 360. It is a dedicated hub that is claimed to bring films and series from southern India together in one place. Netflix says the new experience is available directly on the Netflix homepage and organises titles across languages, genres, stars and moods. Southverse includes theatrical releases such as Peddi, Blast, Amaran, Maharaja, Court: State vs A Nobody and Lucky Bhaskar, alongside Netflix Originals titles.
title: Exclusive: Netflix Launches Southverse as a Dedicated Hub for Easier Discovery of South Indian Content

description: Apple is expected to introduce its first foldable iPhone at the company’s September 9 event, where it is also likely to unveil the iPhone 18 series and new Apple Watch models. The foldable model, which has been widely tipped to be called the iPhone Ultra, is expected to feature a book-style design with a large inner display and a slimmer profile than most competing foldables. Ahead of the launch, a new report has revealed more details about the purported foldable, including its expected MagSafe support.
title: iPhone Ultra Could Reportedly Support MagSafe Charging Despite Ultra-Thin Design, Mark Gurman Says

description: Samsung is said to be preparing to launch the Galaxy S27 series early next year. The rumour mill has suggested that a new Pro model could join the lineup, which is expected to also comprise the Galaxy S27, Galaxy S27 Plus, and Galaxy S27 Ultra. Now, a new report claims Samsung could bring back its Exynos chipset to the top-end Galaxy S model. The Galaxy S27 Ultra is tipped to feature the Exynos 2700 in at least one market, potentially marking the first time since the Galaxy S22 Ultra that an Ultra-series model uses an Exynos SoC.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Tipped to Get Exynos 2700 Chip, Breaking Snapdragon-Only Streak
